description: Remove the background of images with LassoCut. Accepts file paths, folders (their images, not subfolders) or http(s) URLs, up to 50 per call. Saves '<name>-no-bg.<ext>' next to each original (or in output_dir) and never overwrites. Uses size 'preview' (0.25 credit, 50 free a month, up to 10 a day) unless the user explicitly asks for full size.

background.description: 'transparent' (default), a hex color like '#ffffff', or a color name

confirm_cost.description: Set to true only after the user confirmed the full-size cost

images.description: File path, folder path or http(s) URL, or a list of them

light_angle.description: Only with shadow cast. Shadow light angle, -90 to 90; positive means light from the left; default 45

output_dir.description: absolute path; default: next to each original, or your Downloads folder for URLs

preset.description: Marketplace preset, none by default. amazon: Pure white background, product fills 85% of a square image, 2000 px. ebay: Square 1600 px image on white, no borders or text. etsy: 4:3 image, at least 2000 px on the short side, product centred for the thumbnail. shopify: Square 2048 px image, the same ratio across the store. zalando: Portrait 1:1.44 packshot on white, JPEG sRGB, 1801 × 2600 px (no shadow). instagram: Portrait 4:5 post, 1080 × 1350 px. A preset sets the background, format and crop itself (background, format and crop are ignored) and saves a .jpg. Use size full for marketplace uploads; a preview is enlarged and looks soft. Each result is checked and a file that is not compliant is reported. Compliant means compliant with the image rules LassoCut checks.

shadow.description: Cast shadow under the subject, none by default (not available with the zalando preset)

shadow_length.description: Only with shadow cast. Shadow length

shadow_strength.description: Only with shadow cast. Shadow strength, 0 to 100 (soft 35, normal 55, strong 75)

size.description: preview (default) or full (1 credit per image, only if the user asks)

name: remove_background
